panels.title: Stream status
panels.description: Receiver stream health. Healthy: decoded-frame age ≤ max(250 ms, 2 frame periods); delayed until max(1 s, 5 periods), then stalled. A requested stream with no decoded frames is stalled. Idle means capture is intentionally off. Offline means the computer scrape failed; missing instrumentation is No telemetry. Uses the computer target for offline detection. Frame age is measured at the latest scrape, so the five-second scrape interval does not itself appear as a stream stall. Status updates at scrape cadence.

targets.expr: ((((1 + ((max by (node) (clamp_min(timestamp(prysm_receiver_last_decoded_frame_timestamp_seconds{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"}) - prysm_receiver_last_decoded_frame_timestamp_seconds{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"}, 0))) > bool on(node) clamp_min(2 / (max by (node) (prysm_capture_requested_frames_per_second{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"})), 0.25)) + ((max by (node) (clamp_min(timestamp(prysm_receiver_last_decoded_frame_timestamp_seconds{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"}) - prysm_receiver_last_decoded_frame_timestamp_seconds{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"}, 0))) > bool on(node) clamp_min(5 / (max by (node) (prysm_capture_requested_frames_per_second{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"})), 1))) and on(node) ((max by (node) (prysm_capture_requested_frames_per_second{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"})) > 0)) or (0 * ((max by (node) (prysm_capture_requested_frames_per_second{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"})) == 0))) and on(node) (max by (node) (up{job="prysm-nodes",node=~"$node"}) == 1)) or (4 + max by (node) (up{job="prysm-nodes",node="computer",node=~"$node"} == 0))

panels.title: Frame cadence
panels.description: Decoded FPS as a fraction of the active receiver-requested FPS over the selected rate interval. Idle requests have no gauge value; check Stream freshness. Rate calculations need at least two scrapes.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (rate(prysm_pipeline_frames_total{role="Prysm",boundary="Decoded",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / on(node) ((max by (node) (prysm_capture_requested_frames_per_second{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"})) > 0)) and on(node) (max by (node) (up{job="prysm-nodes",node=~"$node"}) == 1)

panels.title: TV capture budget
panels.description: Mean capture iteration wall time divided by the requested frame period. Includes capture, composition, encoding and socket writes, excluding pacing sleep. At 30 FPS the budget is 33.3 ms. Yellow ≥80%; red ≥100%. This measures wall time, not CPU utilization.

targets.expr: ((sum by (node) (rate(prysm_operation_duration_seconds_sum{component="CaptureLoop",operation="Iterate",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (rate(prysm_operation_duration_seconds_count{component="CaptureLoop",operation="Iterate",node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(node) ((max by (node) (prysm_capture_requested_frames_per_second{role="Capturer",node=~"$node"})) > 0)) and on(node) (max by (node) (up{job="prysm-nodes",node=~"$node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Frame regularity
panels.description: Rolling p99 decoded-frame gaps (30-second window), compared with the requested frame interval. Spikes reveal irregular delivery; p99 is a histogram estimate, not an exact per-frame trace. Idle requests are hidden.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le,node) (rate(prysm_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{role="Prysm",operation="FrameArrival",node=~"$node"}[30s])))) and on(node) ((max by (node) (prysm_capture_requested_frames_per_second{role="Prysm",node=~"$node"})) > 0) and on(node) (max by (node) (up{job="prysm-nodes",node=~"$node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Recent faults · 5 minutes
panels.description: Estimated count of failed, timed-out, rejected, truncated or reconnected operation outcomes in the last five minutes, by node. Expected peer closure and intentional idle are excluded. Zero is supplied only for an UP exporter. Multiple faults can belong to the same incident; counts are not unique incidents.

targets.expr: (sum by (node) (increase(prysm_operation_events_total{node=~"$node",outcome=~"Failed|TimedOut|Rejected|Truncated|Reconnected"}[5m])) or on(node) (0 * (max by (node) (up{job="prysm-nodes",node=~"$node"}) == 1))) and on(node) (max by (node) (up{job="prysm-nodes",node=~"$node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Node availability
panels.description: 1 = exporter reachable. Monitoring failure does not stop capture.

panels.title: System collector availability
panels.description: 1 = process and machine statistics available. Initial CPU sample needs a warmup.

panels.title: Whole-machine CPU
panels.description: All CPU cores normalized to 0–100%. Includes TV playback and other applications.

panels.title: Application process CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by this process, including native worker threads. 1 = one full core; values may exceed 1.

panels.title: Machine network traffic per interface
panels.description: Whole-machine interface traffic, including other applications. Avoid summing bridged interfaces: traffic can be counted twice.

panels.title: Pipeline frame rates
panels.description: Frames at explicit component boundaries. These are distinct populations: video/UI acquisition, composition, encoder output, complete local TCP acceptance, complete remote payload, decoded RGB, input dispatch, processed frame, preview publication and WLED DDP write.

panels.title: Application stream bandwidth
panels.description: raw/encoded = codec input/output payload; sent = bytes accepted by the TCP socket, including headers and failed partial frames. TCP/IP overhead and retransmissions are excluded.

panels.title: Encoded payload bytes per prepared frame
panels.description: Prepared payload bytes / successfully encoded frames on this TV. Requested-setting filters select runs; inspect actual wire format/content/codec before comparing. Excludes protocol headers and failed preparation.

panels.title: Compression saving
panels.description: 1 − encoded payload / matching encoder input bytes, including raw fallback. It is byte reduction, not a visual quality score or network delivery ratio.

targets.expr: (1 - sum by (node) (rate(prysm_stream_bytes_total{node=~"$node",boundary="EncoderOutput"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node) (rate(prysm_stream_bytes_total{node=~"$node",boundary="EncoderInput"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(node) (prysm_capture_requested_info{node=~"$node",compression=~"$compression",source=~"$source",width=~"$width",height=~"$height"} == 1)

panels.title: Actual wire encoding and content
panels.description: Actual Header encoding and actual available content on TV encoder output. None can occur during requested LZ4 when compression would expand the frame. Receiver payload counts use Unspecified content because the wire protocol carries no layer provenance.

panels.title: Requested capture configuration
panels.description: Historical TV source, compression and dimensions. The supervised worker has no metrics endpoint; this panel can inspect retained series from earlier exporter runs.

panels.title: Selected native backends
panels.description: Actual currently selected native backend by layer; Disabled means no open capture backend.

panels.title: Processing duration p95
panels.description: Capture acquisition, composition, encoding, decoding and frame processing wall time. Native acquisition can include driver waits; these are not CPU measurements. Socket I/O and whole capture iterations are displayed separately.

panels.title: Processing duration p99
panels.description: Capture acquisition, composition, encoding, decoding and frame processing wall time. Native acquisition can include driver waits; these are not CPU measurements. Socket I/O and whole capture iterations are displayed separately.

panels.title: Waiting and I/O duration p95
panels.description: Socket reads, writes, writable waits and connection establishment, including blocked time. Wait for frame header includes idle time until the next frame arrives. WaitWritable is nested within WriteFrame; do not add these durations.

panels.title: Waiting and I/O duration p99
panels.description: Socket reads, writes, writable waits and connection establishment, including blocked time. Wait for frame header includes idle time until the next frame arrives. WaitWritable is nested within WriteFrame; do not add these durations.

panels.title: Whole capture iteration duration
panels.description: Entire TV capture, composition, encoding and send iteration, excluding pacing sleep. Includes processing and socket waits, so it overlaps both categories above; do not add them.

panels.title: Receiver frame gaps p99
panels.description: Time between complete decoded frames, including reconnect stalls. Not capture-to-host or screen-to-light latency.

panels.title: Operation outcomes by owning component
panels.description: Outcomes attributed at the actual operation boundary. TimedOut is a failure classification, not an additional Failed event. Attempts, successes, retries, intentional skips and errors are distinct.
